scenes.description: Packing a Cute Water Bottle and Lunch Box for the Trip
Benny Showing a Shiny Toy Robot on the Birthday Table
Stargazing at Night Talking about Future Dreams and Wishes

character_line.en: We are getting ready for our outing! What should we put in our backpack?
character_line.zh: 我們正在為郊遊做準備！我們應該在背包裡放些什麼呢？

options.en: A clean water bottle and a lunch box!
options.zh: 一個乾淨的水瓶和一個便當盒！

options.hint: 出門記得帶水瓶「bottle」和便當盒「box」喔！
告訴 Benny 背包裡要裝水瓶和便當！

character_line.en: Great! Did you also bring your cell phone to call home?
character_line.zh: 太棒了！你也有帶手機以便打電話回家嗎？

options.en: Yes, my cell phone is in the front pocket!
options.zh: 有的，我的手機在前口袋裡！

options.en: The desk is made of wood.
options.hint: 回答手機「cell phone」收在前口袋裡喔！
告訴 Benny 手機已經收好了！

character_line.en: Happy birthday! Look at this present! What kind of toy is this?
character_line.zh: 生日快樂！看看這份禮物！這是什麼玩具呢？

options.en: It is a shiny silver robot toy!
options.zh: 這是一隻閃亮的銀色機器人玩具！

options.hint: 用「robot（機器人）」回答這個酷炫玩具喔！
驚喜地說這是一隻機器人玩具吧！

character_line.en: Beep boop! The robot can walk! Did you make a birthday wish?
character_line.zh: 嗶嗶啵啵！機器人會走路！你許生日願望了嗎？

options.en: Yes, I wished for happy days and fun adventures!
options.zh: 許了，我許願每天都快樂、充滿好玩的冒險！

options.hint: 開心分享你的美好生日願望「birthday wish」喔！
告訴 Benny 你許了每天都快樂的願望！

character_line.en: Look up at the starry night sky! What is your biggest dream?
character_line.zh: 抬頭看滿天繁星的夜空！你最大的夢想是什麼？

options.en: My dream is to travel around the world!

options.hint: 分享夢想可以用「My dream is to...」喔！
跟 Benny 說說你心中最棒的大夢想吧！

character_line.en: Traveling the world is incredible! Let's work hard for our dreams!
character_line.zh: 環遊世界太不可思議了！讓我們為了夢想一起努力！

options.en: Yes! Dreams will come true with hard work!
options.zh: 沒錯！努力就能讓夢想成真！

options.hint: 肯定地說「Dreams will come true」夢想成真喔！
跟 Benny 一起為未來的夢想加油！
